name: Something Green, Allegedly
mood: wants something bright, no particular reason
why: Vegan gravy is on the board and correctly labelled, which I respect, and this is the lightest tray available without being a salad. Corn and pickles get along with everything, including each other, which is rare at this counter.
next_time: Same tray, extra pickles, mushroom gravy instead of vegan. I want the chunks.
verdicts: Eat it over the tray. Do not attempt the drive home.
Curds are squeaking. The whole point.
Vegetarian gravy, properly labelled. Nobody is guessing.
Shoestrings under that much gravy are technically a soup now.
